Sync.title: Local documents
Sync.subtitle: Index documents from a local folder (subfolders included) so the chat can use them as context. Files are split into passages and embedded with multilingual-e5-base. Supported: PDF with embedded text, DOCX (with tracked-deletion / strike-through detection), RTF, XLSX, MD, TXT. Scanned PDFs and images are skipped.
Sync.label: Label (optional)
Sync.removeConfirm: Remove this folder from the configuration? Files on disk are not touched. Embeddings stay in Lance until you manually purge them.
Sync.noFolders: No folders configured yet. Add one above to get started.
Sync.modelHint: First download is ~280 MB and happens once; subsequent scans start offline.

pii.tooltip: Strip personal data (names, emails, fiscal codes, IBAN…) from this file before it reaches the model
pii.disclaimerBody: PII protection runs a black-box AI model that scans the file's extracted text and replaces personal-data spans (names, emails, fiscal codes, IBAN, …) with placeholders before the document is sent to the model. The detector can be imprecise: some entities may slip through unfiltered and reach the LLM anyway.
pii.omissisHintPrefix: For production-grade, audited redaction we recommend Omissis, available at
pii.statusLoading: Loading PII model… first run downloads ~500 MB from HuggingFace, then loads the ONNX session.
pii.statusFailed: Could not load the PII model
pii.statusUnavailable: PII protection requested but this build of {product} was compiled without the ner-pii feature — the document will be sent unredacted.

reject.intro: Explain why you want to reject this version. The model will use this note on subsequent turns so it doesn't reproduce the same mistake.
reject.placeholder: e.g. the anamnesis section doesn't correctly list the patient's known allergies…
reject.summaryExplain: This summary + your reason will enter the context of subsequent turns in place of the full document.

summaryModal.title: Rejection summary — «{file}»
summaryModal.intro: This is what the model sees on subsequent chat turns in place of the rejected document.
summaryModal.explain: To restore the original document, switch the decision back to Accept — the summary stays archived in case you reject again.
summaryModal.noSummary: No summary is archived for this rejection. The user reason is still injected into the chat context, but no LLM-generated digest accompanies it.

cleanup.title: Source file removed
cleanup.body: This document appears to have been removed from disk. Its embeddings remain in the index and the assistant may hallucinate it as a source on every turn. Run a cleanup to drop the orphan rows.

cleanup.noOrphans: No orphan sources found — the index is already clean

Settings.retrievalIntro: Behavioural knobs that change how the assistant searches your library at chat time. Each one is opt-in and can be turned off without restarting {product}.
Settings.retrievalHydeDescription: Before searching, the assistant drafts a short pseudo-answer in the register of the active domain (legal / medical / finance / …) and uses it as a second probe. The two rankings are merged. Tends to recover passages that match the answer's phrasing rather than the question's.
Settings.retrievalHydeCost: Adds one extra LLM call per chat turn. Cost is paid on your active provider (Anthropic / Gemini / OpenAI / local), not local compute.
Settings.retrievalHydeEnabledToast: HyDE enabled — next chat turn will use it
Settings.retrievalHydeDisabledToast: HyDE disabled — back to pure cosine retrieval
Settings.piiThresholdHint: Confidence threshold the model uses to decide whether a piece of text is personal data. Lowering it masks more text and produces more false positives (a company name read as a person); raising it leaves doubtful cases in clear text. A value that is recognised is always masked at every occurrence in the document.
